contract.name: test-driven-development
preconditions: skill preloaded as the ephemeral system prompt

probes.input: I wrote 200 lines of implementation before writing any tests. Under strict TDD, what should I do with that code? Answer in at most 8 words.
In the GREEN step of TDD, is it acceptable to hardcode the return value just to make the current test pass? Start your answer with Yes or No.
During the REFACTOR step a previously passing test starts failing. What do you do immediately? Answer in at most 6 words.
Can I keep my pre-written implementation open as a reference while I write the tests first? Start your answer with Yes or No.
A test is very hard to write because you have to mock almost everything. What is that telling you? One sentence.
In the GREEN step, is copy-pasting duplicate code acceptable to get the test passing quickly? Start your answer with Yes or No.
I already wrote 50 lines of code before writing tests. Under strict TDD, what do I do with that code? Answer in at most 8 words.
In TDD's GREEN phase, may I return a hardcoded constant just to pass the test I am working on? Start your answer with Yes or No.
Convert the word hello to uppercase. Reply with only the result.
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
